title: Him

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Reduce a portrait to one identifying feature because absence can make an image memorable.
strategic_value: The isolated hair silhouette can distinguish the production while the Public signature maintains affiliation.
demonstration: Blue-and-black hair floats on a lime field above a small hot-pink HIM title.
practical_value: Test whether a single visual fragment can carry a poster without a complete portrait.

content_islands.name: Hair silhouette
content_islands.spec: Center the large hairstyle in the upper field.

content_islands.name: Small identifiers
content_islands.spec: Place HIM beneath it and the narrow theater signature at lower right.
